recommendations.body: `synchronize_concepts()` in `plan_tool/concept_sync.py` (step 5 “Add the canonical concept and plan synchronizer”) compares the current sidecar with the mutated `reviewed_tree`, not the record snapshot loaded before review. A legitimate in-memory review therefore requires an early sidecar write, while a caller that avoids that write receives a false source-divergence result
recommendations.suggested_action: add an explicit original concept snapshot or exact source bytes to `synchronize_concepts()` and compare the on-disk sidecar against that snapshot before staging the reviewed tree
